notes: v1.0.33 — Update staleness fix: the launcher could keep reporting the PREVIOUS version as "latest / up to date" for up to 5 minutes after a release. Root cause: Electron net.fetch (Chromium stack) honors Cache-Control and served the manifest from its own local HTTP cache (raw.githubusercontent.com sends max-age=300), so every 15s re-check hit the cache instead of the live feed. Fix: ghFetch now passes cache no-store, so every update check and download always hits the network fresh — a new version is detected immediately, no stale cache window. Same guarantees as 1.0.31/1.0.32: asset resolved from installer + direct url, no silent repo-zip fallback on packaged installs, SHA-256 verified downloads.
